title: feat(service-map): ducks quack and hop when clicked

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge The scene folder has no test harness at all, and the paused-map hop budget is counted in frames, so fast displays freeze it mid-hop. 1 note · tests missing −2 · risk low Adds a synthesized Web Audio quack and a click-triggered hop to the 3D service map's ducks, wired into the demand render loop. Safe to merge; the paused-map hop is budgeted in frames rather than seconds, so it can freeze mid-hop on fast displays. - `quacker` builds a two-`wak` Web Audio quack and closes its `AudioContext` on `stop()` - Each duck group carries `userData.quack`, which sets a real-time hop on the body group - `pickDuck` runs on a machine-miss click within `DRAG_TOLERANCE`, before clearing the selection - An invisible `BoxGeometry` hit box makes the small ducks clickable ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · Paused hop's 60-frame budget freezes the duck on high-refresh displays correctness · [`apps/web/src/page/service-map/three/scene.ts:252`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/c2fb9cc97e9bda005edfdc93beace4e3ddafe087/apps/web/src/page/service-map/three/scene.ts#L252) The hop only advances while demand frames render, and `state.pending = 60` buys 0.42 s at 144 Hz and 0.36 s at 165 Hz, short of `HOP`'s 0.45 s (it needs 65 and 75 frames). The last frame leaves the duck up to 7 cm off the water and 13° tilted until something else invalidates the scene. Budget the demand frames from `HOP` and the refresh rate, or keep requesting frames while `duck.hop > 0`. ``` Budget frames from time rather than a fixed count: pass the refresh rate (or `HOP`) to the scene and set `state.pending` to `Math.ceil(HOP * hz / 1000) + 2`, or have the scenery ask for another frame while a hop is live. ```
What was checked - A duck click only fires on a machine miss and within `DRAG_TOLERANCE` (`scene.ts:246`), so pans and machine clicks keep their existing semantics - Ducks sit under the scenery root that `pickDuck` traverses (`forest.ts:99`, `critters.ts:61`), and `stop()` closes the audio context (`scene.ts:284`) - The audio graph stays within bounds: one context per scene, shut down on unmount
`c2fb9cc` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge
Contained decorative change and the head commit fixes F1; the duck click, hop and quack have no test, as nothing in `three/` is tested.
<sub>no findings · tests missing −2 · risk low</sub>

Clicking a mallard on the 3D service map now quacks (synthesized Web Audio) and hops, with a hidden hit box and a time-based wake so the hop still plays on a paused map. Safe to merge; the F1 frame-budget freeze is fixed at this head.

- `pickDuck` raycasts each duck's hidden box before a miss clears the selection
- A duck click opens the `AudioContext` and plays the double `wak`
- `awakeUntil` keeps the demand loop drawing through the hop while paused
- `HOP` is exported from `critters.ts` for the scene to read

### Fixed since the last review

- ✅ ~~F1 · Paused hop's 60-frame budget freezes the duck on high-refresh displays~~

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `awakeUntil` uses `performance.now()` and is compared against the rAF timestamp, same origin (`scene.ts:255`), and spans 500 ms of drawn frames for a 450 ms hop at 60–240 Hz
- The hit box's `MeshBasicMaterial({ visible: false })` does not block picking: three's raycaster tests object visibility, not material visibility (`critters.ts:57`)
- `duck.hop` lives on the flock entry shared by the `userData.quack` closure and the frame callback, so a click reaches the hop for the duck that was hit (`critters.ts:60`)

</details>

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Contained to the lazy scene chunk: hop timing, hit-box picking and the awake window all check out against `critters.ts` and the demand loop.
<sub>no findings · tests not needed · risk low</sub>

Clicking a duck on the 3D service map now hops it and plays a synthesized quack, via a duck-only pick path that no longer clears the selection. The work stays inside the lazy scene chunk, and I found no defect to hold it.

- `ducks` adds an invisible hit box per duck carrying `userData.quack`, which sets a landing time
- `pickDuck` raycasts only those boxes, so a duck click skips `onSelect(null)`
- `state.awakeUntil` keeps the paused demand loop drawing through the whole hop
- `quacker` builds the double wak with Web Audio on the first click, closed in `stop`

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- Repeat clicks keep the hop phase in [0,1]: `landsAt` is always `now + HOP` (`critters.ts:66,88`)
- `visible: false` material only skips drawing — `Mesh.raycast` never tests it, so the boxes still pick
- Duck groups and their closures are rebuilt with the scenery, so hop state cannot outlive its meshes

</details>
